vb_textbox.text: Ignore the color of the mushroom hats and instead focus on their length. As far as I can tell the color does not matter, there are 2 forests you can go to and which you go to depends on the length of the mushroom hats. You will be given a choice between one with a longer hat and one with a shorter hat. Choose one and see how many mushrooms you get. If you get 5 or more keep selecting the mushroom with that length. When you start getting 4 mushrooms or less switch over to the other length and if it gives 5 or more keep selecting that length instead. If it also gives 4 or less keep alternating back and forth between the 2 lengths until one gives 5 or more and then stick to that length. Repeat this until you complete the task. The range of points you can get is 0-9. Using the method described I ended up with just over 1100 points.
